Its cutting capabilities are improved, and its durability has seen a slight uptick.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 30 |durability = 26 |flammable = No |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = Yes |throw = Yes |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Guardian Sword+}} Guardian Swords+ are [[Weapon]]s wielded by [[Guardian Scout III|Guardian Scouts III]] in "A Moderate Test of Strength" [[Ancient Shrine]]s. They can be obtained by defeating the [[Guardian Scout]]s that use them. In addition to this, they have a chance to appear in [[Treasure Chest]]s that spawn after scanning the {{BotW}} Series [[Guardian]] [[amiibo]] with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]. Guardian Swords+ are more powerful than regular [[Guardian Sword]]s, and they slightly more durability as well. Being made from [[Ancient Technology]], Guardian Swords+ will deal additional damage when used again Guardian-type [[Enemy|Enemies]]. They will float if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], and they will not burn if exposed to [[Fire]] or equipped in a [[Scorching Climate]]. Finally, the [[Magnesis]] Rune will not be able to pick them up, and they do not conduct [[Electricity]] or attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s. Guardian Swords+ belong to the [[Guardian Gear]] equipment archetype, which includes all Weapons used by Guardian Scouts in Ancient Shrines.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 175}} {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Sword_014" |Life = 26 |Power = 30 |SpHitActor = Actors with tags "TeamGuardian", "IsEffectiveAncientWeapon"; "Enemy_Ganon", "Enemy_SiteBoss_", "Enemy_Guardian_Mini_" {{List Note|All Guardians and Guardian Scouts, Calamity Ganon and Dark Beast Ganon, All Ganon Blights, Guardian legs/propellers}} |SpHitRatio = 1.3 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 5 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 6 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 6 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 9 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 7 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 13 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 1.0 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 30 |BuyingPrice = 75 }} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Link One-Handed Weapon }} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW Guardian Sword+ Inactive Model.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Inactive Guardian Sword+ File:AoC Guardian Sword+ Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for the Guardian Sword+ ==See Also== {{See Also| * Ancient Technology * Guardian Gear * Guardian Sword * Guardian Sword++ * Weapon }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Ancient Technology, Ancient Weapons, Guardian Gear, One-Handed Weapons, Swords, Weapons |items= BotW, AoC }}
